verdict.rationale: Feitian documents FIDO2/WebAuthn compatibility and Azure AD passwordless sign-in to PC and web services "without typing anything," which implies usernameless sign-in. The Android iePassManager tool's "credential related operations" suggests on-key credential management. Discoverable or resident credentials are never named explicitly, so the capability is inferred rather than documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of resident-key or discoverable-credential support, stated storage capacity for resident credentials, usernameless flows on generic WebAuthn services beyond Azure AD, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
